findings.title: Unfiltered request body bound to User model in /profile

evidence.why: User.findByIdAndUpdate(req.user._id, req.body, ...) binds the entire request body to the User model without filtering privileged fields such as role.

findings.impact: Privilege escalation via the role field
findings.recommendation: Whitelist allowed fields or set privileged fields server‑side; do not bind the raw request body.

findings.title: Unfiltered request body bound to User model in register

evidence.why: User::create($request->all()) binds all request fields to the User model, including privileged fields such as role.

findings.impact: Privilege escalation via the role field
findings.recommendation: Use a fillable/allowlist or explicitly set privileged fields server‑side.

findings.title: Owner ID writable in Team creation

evidence.why: Team::create($request->all()) allows the owner_id field to be set by the client.

findings.recommendation: Do not allow owner_id to be set by the client; set it server‑side based on the authenticated user.

findings.title: Unfiltered request body bound to User in PATCH /users/<uid>

evidence.why: for key, value in request.json.items(): setattr(user, key, value) binds all fields, including privileged ones such as role.

findings.impact: Privilege escalation via the role field
findings.recommendation: Whitelist editable fields or set privileged fields server‑side.
